name: BG1.1 load Sydney Water Quality (200 rows) from its card
navigates: (async()=>{for(let i=0;i<50;i++){const b=document.querySelector('#builtin-grid [data-builtin="au.water"]');if(b){b.click();return true;}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));}return false;})()

name: BG1.1 the dataset is loaded on this page with all 200 rows
BG1.1 Generate: loke answers the model's reply as JSON with the DDL text intact, and the page takes it as a dashboard, not as plain text
js: await (async()=>{window.__bg.gen=await __bgRun('generateDashboard','dash-prompt','Show me water quality by suburb');const c=window.__bg.gen.calls;if(c.length!==1)return JSON.stringify({calls:c.length});const res=JSON.parse(c[0].res);const m=String(res.response||'').match(/```json\s*([\s\S]*?)```/);const ddl=m&&JSON.parse(m[1]);const banner=document.getElementById('error-banner');return (c[0].status===200&&res.ok===true&&c[0].req.mode==='dashboard'&&ddl&&ddl.cards.length===4&&ddl.cards[0].id==='m-count'&&!banner.classList.contains('visible')&&document.querySelectorAll('#dash-grid .dash-card').length===4&&document.getElementById('ph1').classList.contains('ph-done'))||JSON.stringify({status:c[0].status,res:c[0].res.slice(0,200),banner:banner.textContent});})()

name: BG1.3 Phase 1 sent the schema profile and no data value
js: await (async()=>{const t=window.__bg.gen.calls[0].req.text;const d=__bgRows();const leaked=d.rows.slice(0,50).map(r=>r[d.headers.indexOf('reading_id')]).filter(v=>t.indexOf(v)>=0);return (t.indexOf('Design a dashboard as a JSON DDL object')>=0&&t.indexOf('temperature_c | numeric')>=0&&leaked.length===0)||JSON.stringify({leaked,head:t.slice(0,160)});})()

name: BG1.3 Phase 2 computed three of the four cards locally from the 200 rows, and says so
js: await (async()=>{const p=document.getElementById('ph2');return (p.classList.contains('ph-done')&&/3 of 4 cards computed locally from 200 rows/.test(p.textContent))||p.className+' '+p.textContent;})()

name: BG1.3 the metric cards show the figures computed from the loaded rows (count of reading_id, mean of temperature_c), not the model's 999999
BG1.3 Phase 3 plots the per-suburb mean of ph computed from the rows, and drops the model's invented series
js: await (async()=>{const ch=window.__bg.gen.charts;const d=__bgRows();const xi=d.headers.indexOf('suburb'),yi=d.headers.indexOf('ph');const g=new Map();d.rows.forEach(r=>{const v=parseFloat(r[yi]);if(isNaN(v))return;const k=String(r[xi]);const e=g.get(k)||{s:0,c:0};e.s+=v;e.c++;g.set(k,e);});const c=ch.find(x=>x.id==='canvas-c-ph');if(!c)return JSON.stringify(ch);const ok=c.labels.length===g.size&&c.labels.every((l,i)=>g.has(l)&&Math.abs(c.data[0][i]-g.get(l).s/g.get(l).c)<1e-9);return (ok&&!c.labels.includes('Invented')&&c.data[0].indexOf(424242)<0&&!!__bgCard('c-ph').querySelector('canvas'))||JSON.stringify(c);})()

name: BG1.3 a card naming a column the data does not have is unresolved and shows no number
BG1.3 Refine: the model is sent the current dashboard as column references only, and its refined DDL is resolved locally again
js: await (async()=>{window.__bg.ref=await __bgRun('refineDashboard','refine-prompt','Add peak turbidity');const c=window.__bg.ref.calls;if(c.length!==1)return JSON.stringify({calls:c.length});const t=c[0].req.text;const mean=__bgFmt(__bgNums('temperature_c').reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/200);const res=JSON.parse(c[0].res);return (res.ok===true&&t.indexOf('Refine this dashboard specification')>=0&&t.indexOf('"query_col":"temperature_c"')>=0&&t.indexOf('resolved_value')<0&&t.indexOf(mean)<0&&t.indexOf('999999')<0&&!!__bgCard('m-turb')&&!__bgCard('m-ghost'))||JSON.stringify({t:t.slice(0,300),ok:res.ok});})()

name: BG1.3 the refined card shows the maximum of turbidity_ntu computed from the rows, and all four cards resolved
js: await (async()=>{const mx=Math.max(...__bgNums('turbidity_ntu'));const v=__bgCard('m-turb').querySelector('.metric-value').textContent;const p=document.getElementById('ph2');return (v===__bgFmt(mx)+'NTU'&&/4 of 4 cards computed locally from 200 rows/.test(p.textContent)&&document.getElementById('ph3').classList.contains('ph-done'))||JSON.stringify({v,mx,p:p.textContent});})()
